summary: H1 2026 operating cash flow was NEGATIVE KRW 370.7B against POSITIVE KRW 1,014.3B in H1 2025 — a swing of about KRW 1.39T — while reporting KRW 2.00T of operating profit. Cash generated from operations before interest and tax was also negative, at KRW 139.8B. Investing cash flow was negative KRW 3,403.0B. Interest paid KRW 264.7B.
source: 한화에어로스페이스 반기보고서 (제50기 반기, 기준일 2026-06-30, 제출 2026-08-14), DART — tier-1
analyst_note: THE DECISIVE FINDING OF THIS ANALYSIS. Accounting profit and cash generation have decoupled. Long-cycle defence and shipbuilding contracts do accumulate contract assets before milestone billing, so this can be timing — but a KRW 1.39T year-on-year swing while reporting KRW 2T of operating profit cannot be waved through. FY2025 full-year operating cash flow is the single most important missing number in this file.

summary: H1 2026 segment revenue: 해양 KRW 9,614.2B (63.91%), 방산 KRW 4,465.2B (29.68%), 항공 KRW 1,459.0B (9.70%), IT서비스 KRW 362.4B, 항공우주 KRW 124.4B. Operating profit: 해양 KRW 1,150.3B (57.39%), 방산 KRW 903.7B (45.09%), 항공 KRW 67.2B. FY2025 comparatives: 해양 54.5% of revenue with KRW 1,115.3B operating profit; 방산 38.9% with KRW 2,272.6B.
source: 한화에어로스페이스 반기보고서 (제50기 반기, 기준일 2026-06-30, 제출 2026-08-14), DART — tier-1
analyst_note: THE SCREENING THESIS WAS WRONG ABOUT WHAT THIS COMPANY IS. The 2026-09-04 screening run treated 012450 as a European-rearmament defence play. By revenue it is now 64% SHIPBUILDING — a cyclical industry with a historically poor record on returns on capital. Marine also overtook defence on operating profit in H1 2026.

summary: 방산 H1 2026 revenue KRW 4,465.2B against an FY2025 half-year run-rate of KRW 5,191.6B — about -14%. Defence operating margin also fell from 21.9% (FY2025) to 20.2% (H1 2026). Revenue by type: 방산 exports KRW 1,948.3B and domestic KRW 2,281.6B in H1 2026, against FY2025 totals of KRW 4,672.5B and KRW 5,209.1B.
source: 한화에어로스페이스 반기보고서 (제50기 반기, 기준일 2026-06-30, 제출 2026-08-14), DART — tier-1
analyst_note: The moat leg is deteriorating on BOTH revenue and margin while the lower-moat marine leg grows. This is the opposite of the direction-of-change evidence agents/deep-analyst.md prioritises, and it is why moat_trajectory scores 8/15.

summary: Total order backlog KRW 114,918.2B at 2026-06-30: 한화에어로 방산 KRW 38,307.3B, 한화오션 해양 KRW 33,008.4B, 한화에어로 항공 KRW 31,723.1B, 한화시스템 방산 KRW 8,537.9B, 한화시스템 IT KRW 2,780.7B, 쎄트렉아이 KRW 557.4B. Total order value KRW 158,551.5B less delivered KRW 43,633.3B.
source: 한화에어로스페이스 반기보고서 (제50기 반기, 기준일 2026-06-30, 제출 2026-08-14), DART — tier-1
analyst_note: THE STRONGEST POSITIVE IN THE FILE. About 3.8 years of revenue at the H1 2026 annualised rate. Defence backlog alone is KRW 46.85T. This is genuine forward visibility and is why the structural case is not dismissed outright.

summary: Shares outstanding rose from 45,581,161 (2024 year-end) to 51,563,401 — 5,982,240 new shares, 13.1% dilution — via a third-party placement of 1,715,040 shares on 2025-04-29 and a rights issue with public offering of 4,267,200 shares on 2025-07-10. The count has been flat since. Treasury stock 114,613 shares (0.22%). Historical context: 50,630,000 shares at 2022 and 2023 year-end, reduced by the 2024-09-01 spin-off.
source: 한화에어로스페이스 반기보고서 (제50기 반기, 기준일 2026-06-30, 제출 2026-08-14), DART — tier-1
analyst_note: RESOLVES THE PRIMARY GATE FLAGGED AT SCREENING. The dilution is confirmed and quantified at 13.1%, but it was a DISCRETE 2025 event rather than an ongoing pattern — the count has been flat for twelve months. That is why persistent_dilution reads MEDIUM rather than HIGH. The concern is forward-looking: borrowings rose 24.6% in the six months AFTER the raise.

summary: At 2026-06-30: total assets KRW 58,742.0B, total liabilities KRW 38,504.9B, total equity KRW 20,237.1B of which owners' share KRW 11,998.9B and non-controlling interests KRW 8,238.3B. Cash KRW 8,048.2B. Borrowings and bonds: current KRW 9,545.3B (from KRW 6,982.2B) and non-current KRW 5,899.5B (from KRW 5,412.7B) — total KRW 15,444.8B from KRW 12,394.9B, +24.6% in six months. Current assets KRW 32,904.3B against current liabilities KRW 30,493.1B — a current ratio of 1.08.
source: 한화에어로스페이스 반기보고서 (제50기 반기, 기준일 2026-06-30, 제출 2026-08-14), DART — tier-1
analyst_note: Net debt of roughly KRW 7.40T and rising, with a 1.08 current ratio and negative operating cash flow. The weakest survivability profile in this harness — Samsung, NVDA and TSM hold net cash, and AVGO though levered generates large free cash flow.

summary: H1 2026 continuing-operations profit was KRW 1,606.8B but profit attributable to owners of the parent was only KRW 897.1B — non-controlling interests took about 44%. FY2025: continuing profit KRW 2,202.0B versus owners' KRW 1,405.0B. FY2024 owners' profit was KRW 2,298.9B on revenue of only KRW 11,240.1B.
source: 한화에어로스페이스 반기보고서 (제50기 반기, 기준일 2026-06-30, 제출 2026-08-14), DART — tier-1
analyst_note: Consolidated figures materially OVERSTATE what reaches Hanwha Aerospace shareholders. Note also that FY2024 owners' profit (KRW 2,299B) EXCEEDED FY2025 (KRW 1,405B) despite revenue more than doubling — the FY2024 figure evidently contained one-off items, so neither year is a clean base.

summary: Group operating margin improved from 11.6% (FY2025, KRW 3,089.3B on KRW 26,702.9B) to 13.3% (H1 2026, KRW 2,004.4B on KRW 15,043.9B). Marine segment margin improved from 7.7% to 12.0%; defence 21.9% to 20.2%; aviation 0.5% to 4.6%.
source: 한화에어로스페이스 반기보고서 (제50기 반기, 기준일 2026-06-30, 제출 2026-08-14), DART — tier-1
analyst_note: The one genuinely favourable operating trend. Growth bought with price would compress margin; this does not, which is why low_quality_growth reads INVESTIGATE rather than FAIL. Marine margin doubling is real operational improvement.

summary: Revenue went from KRW 11,240.1B (FY2024) to KRW 26,702.9B (FY2025), +137%. The 해양 segment alone was KRW 14,558.4B in FY2025. Non-controlling interests of KRW 6,496.9B at 2024 year-end rising to KRW 8,238.3B indicate a large partly-owned subsidiary.
source: 한화에어로스페이스 반기보고서 (제50기 반기, 기준일 2026-06-30, 제출 2026-08-14), DART — tier-1
analyst_note: The FY2024-to-FY2025 jump reflects the CONSOLIDATION of Hanwha Ocean, not organic growth. Any growth-rate comparison spanning that boundary is meaningless, and presenting +137% as growth would be a category error. Flagged so the number is not reused elsewhere.

summary: At KRW 1,244,000 per share and 51,563,401 shares outstanding, market capitalisation is about KRW 64.14T. Against owners' equity of KRW 11,998.9B (BPS about KRW 232,703) that is 5.35x book. On FY2025 owners' EPS of about KRW 27,247 the trailing P/E is 45.7x; on H1 2026 annualised owners' EPS of about KRW 34,796 it is 35.8x. Enterprise value including net debt of KRW 7.40T and minorities of KRW 8.24T is roughly KRW 79.8T, or about 19.9x H1 2026 annualised operating profit.
source: Market price (press-sourced) combined with tier-1 share count and equity from the 반기보고서
analyst_note: Market price is a tier-4 input; the share count and equity are tier-1. Probability-weighted five-year return is approximately NEGATIVE 37% — the only negative expected return in this harness.

summary: The supplied FY2025 [정정]영업보고서 (2026-03-19) is an IMAGE-BASED PDF: text extraction returns only the correction notice and page markers, with no financial statements. The 반기보고서 cash flow statement carries only H1 comparatives (H1 2026 vs H1 2025), not FY2025 full-year figures. FY2025 full-year operating cash flow is therefore NOT obtainable from the documents supplied. Separately, the correction changed 기업결합 사항, 타회사 출자현황 and the 이사회 결의서 — administrative items, NOT a restatement of financial statements.
analyst_note: CORRECTS THE RED TEAM'S PREMISE. The red team returned REVISE partly on the ground that FY2025 operating cash flow was available in a supplied document and had not been extracted. That premise is false — the document contains no machine-readable financials. The underlying criticism still stands in substance (the number is decisive and remains unknown), but the analysis did not fail to use data it had.

summary: Consolidated total borrowings of KRW 12,433.1B at 2025-09-30 with net debt/EBITDA of 1.6x; financial coverage described as excellent. On H1 2026 annualised operating profit of about KRW 4.01T plus depreciation, current net debt of roughly KRW 7.40T implies net debt/EBITDA nearer 1.2-1.3x.
source: KIS Rating credit report, January 2026 — tier-3
analyst_note: CORRECTS AN EARLIER DRAFT OF THIS FILE, which characterised survivability as the weakest in the harness partly on the debt level. The leverage LEVEL is conservative by conventional metrics. financial_survivability raised 6 to 7. The genuine concern is narrower and unchanged: a 1.08 current ratio and NEGATIVE operating cash flow while borrowings rose 24.6% in six months.
